events.quote_anchor: He squinted and saw it lying on the ground, several yards away, but as he limped toward the weapon, it disappeared.

events.quote_anchor: it was long enough for a third agent, the one he couldn’t see, to bring something—the shotgun barrel, if Mitch had to guess—down onto his outstretched arm.

events.did: stepped out of empty night in front of Mitch and greeted him by the fake name Jack
events.quote_anchor: “Hello again, Jack,” he said, laying emphasis on the fake name Mitch had used in Herald.

events.did: drew a smaller weapon and fired three rounds straight into Mitch's chest
